boosters_i18n.zh-TW: 布魯克斯河沿斷層跌落的階梯瀑布：水量判據由 72h 累積雨量映射；夏季棕熊在瀑布捕鮭是季節性生態主體，實際可遇性由現場公告與野生動物狀態決定，不納入即時評估判據。
boosters_i18n.en: The Brooks River drops over a terrace fault in stepped falls; flow is judged by the trailing-72h-rain mapped state. Summer brown bears fishing the falls are a seasonal ecological subject whose presence on the day is decided on site and is deliberately not part of the live evaluation criteria.
